Pokémon Psyduck Yellow

Oak’s Parcel playtest · Prototype 008

Select your original USA HeartGold .nds file, then press the button to create your playable prototype.

Your original file stays on your device. It is never uploaded or changed.

Select your original file to begin.

Download prototype 008.nds

Open the downloaded NDS in your Android DS emulator. Start a new game to test the opening, or import a backed-up prototype 004, 005, 006 or 007 normal save through your emulator. Emulator save states should not be transferred between builds.

This is an opening prototype, not a complete Yellow remake. Route 1 now opens after Mom gives you Running Shoes. The cashier greets you outside Viridian and escorts you into the Mart. Deliver Oak’s Parcel to receive the National Pokédex. Areas beyond Viridian remain blocked. Imported saves keep their caught records, but Pokédex access waits for parcel delivery. Evolution supplies remain available in the player’s PC.
